correctness.rationale: The exact killed chain on the finitely many marked vertices is a true lumping; the zero-arrival kernel has a simple eigenvalue 1 and spectral gap 1/r. Its normalized left eigenvector has one-marked-state mass r/(n-r)+O(n^-2), producing the universal escape coefficient 2(r-1)k/n^2+O(n^-3). Uniform-in-fixed-k expansions imply Poisson missing pairs and a standard Gumbel time; an independent one-pair tail bound proves expectation asymptotics. The actual packaged standard-library checker passed 212 assertions comparing rational full and reduced chain survival, and numerical spectral rates. Finite checks are corroboration only, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Conjecture 2.4 of Athreya--Mukherjee--Mukherjee explicitly leaves the Markovian s=2, r>2 case unresolved. Theorem 2.5 covers only s=r and their Gumbel theorem covers independent block draws. Fixed-dimensional killed-chain spectral expansion derives new Markovian pair coverage and a standard Gumbel law for every fixed r>=3. The strongest available directly relevant full primary article and independent-block references were compared by hypotheses and conclusions; historical completeness cannot be guaranteed.
